instructions: TypeSafe Jev (System One) evaluation server. Use `jev_evaluate` to run parallel batches of `noul` (yes/no probability), `choice` (1..255 options), `score` (2..10 rubric levels), or `box` questions over any JSON/text `state` in a single ~100ms call. For question design patterns and System One best practices, read the embedded skill resource `jev://skill` (or compact `jev://guide`) on demand.
